download_4dgt_full_model: download the 4DGT full pretrained model from Hugging Face Hub to the checkpoints directory
download_4dgt_1st_stage_model: download the 4DGT first stage pretrained model from Hugging Face Hub to a custom output directory
force_redownload_4dgt_model: force re-download the 4DGT model from Hugging Face Hub even if it already exists locally
download_4dgt_model_custom_repo: download a 4DGT model from a custom Hugging Face repository ID to a specified output directory
run_download_model_cli: run the download model CLI script with argparse to download 4DGT pretrained models from Hugging Face
